_comment: P2-7 Vercel AI SDK 7 bodies EN（2026-11-03）。sections 与源侧固定小节对齐；sources 按索引对齐 frontmatter。

axes.model_access: Connects to multiple model providers through provider packages; model switching happens in application code. AI SDK 7 adds HarnessAgent, which treats existing agent harnesses as switchable runtimes (official changelog).
axes.runtime: A TypeScript/JavaScript library running inside your Node, edge or browser app; harness adapters drive external agent runtimes such as Claude Code, Codex and Pi, with sandboxes supplied by the adapter (the official example uses Vercel Sandbox).
axes.local_files: File access depends on the harness and sandbox: the official example uses createVercelSandbox for an isolated filesystem; local-file access not verified item by item.
axes.background: The library ships no task queue; whether long tasks continue in the background depends on the chosen harness and sandbox runtime.
axes.tools: Tool calling is a core abstraction; the official changelog shows HarnessAgent combined with sandboxes. MCP integration not verified item by item.
axes.context: Message history is managed by the application; the library has no built-in persistence, so you attach a database or session store yourself.
axes.permissions: Mostly BYOK with keys on the application side; sandbox boundaries come from the harness adapter, and the official example uses Vercel Sandbox as the isolation layer. Multi-tenant isolation is your design.
axes.fit: Fits TypeScript/JS teams building agent apps who want to switch models or harnesses without rewriting business code. Does not fit turnkey agents (see coding/chat products) or Python ecosystems (see LangGraph/Agno).

runs: This site has not completed integration or performance tests; the conclusions cover the API and capabilities disclosed in official docs only.
unknowns:
- Official support status for MCP integration (not verified item by item)
- Permission and sandbox differences across harness adapters (not verified item by item)
- Local-file access and adapters beyond Vercel Sandbox
related: Both are agent application frameworks; AI SDK leans TS/JS and multiple harnesses.
A programming interface for a single harness, contrasting with AI SDK's multi-harness route.
